# Import Libraries
```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(Hmisc)
library(corrplot)
library(PerformanceAnalytics)
source("Code/Functions/CorrelationFunction.R")
options(scipen = 999)
```

#Import Data
```{r import data}
# use 03-OceanWaterQualityData-QCCutoff.csv
df <- read_csv("Data/Clean/YSI/02_QualityControl/02-YSI-Data-QCCutoff.csv")
```

## Create Correlation Matrix
```{r correlation matrix}
df_cor <- df %>%
  # take out columns that will give NA values in correlations (not enough observations)
  select(-date, -time, -chlorophyll_ugL, 
         -total_algae_cellsL, -total_dissolved_solids_mgL) %>%
  rename(`Chlorophyll (RFU)` = chlorophyll_rfu,
         `Conductivity (µS/cm)` = conductivity_uScm,
         `Dissolved Oxygen, Local (%)` = do_local_percent,
         `Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)` = do_mgL,
         `Dissolved Oxygen, Saturated (%)` = do_saturated_percent,
         `Conductivity, Non-Linear Function (µS/cm)` = nlf_conductivity_uScm,
         `Oxygen Reduction Potential (mV)` = orp_mV,
         `pH (mV)` = pH_mV,
         `Salinity (PSU)` = salinity_psu,
         `Conductivity, Specific (µS/cm)` = sp_conductivity_uScm,
         `Temperature (ºC)` = temp_c,
         `Temperature (ºF)` = temp_f,
         `Total Algae (RFU)` = total_algae_rfu)

```

## Get Significant Statistics
```{r significant stats}
# create nested list of matrices: p-values, n, r values
cor_mat_stats <- rcorr(as.matrix(cor_mat))

cor_mat_pvals <- cor_mat_stats$P

# full flattened correlation matrix
cor_mat_stats_flat <- flattenCorrMatrix(cor_mat_stats$r, cor_mat_stats$P) %>%
  mutate(across(3:4, ~ round(.x, 2))) 


```

## Correlation Plots
``` {r cor plots}
# Correlogram
{ # open pdf graphics driver
  pdf(file = "Figures/YSI/04_Correlations/01-YSI-Correlations-Correlogram.pdf", 
      width = 13, height = 10)
  # make correlation plot
  corrplot(cor_mat_stats$r, method = "number", type = "full", diag = TRUE,
           order = "original", 
           tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, mar = c(0, 0, 3, 0),
           title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean YSI Water Quality Correlations")
  # close graphics driver
  dev.off()
}

# Correlogram with Significance
cor_mat_stats$P[is.na(cor_mat_stats$P)] <- 1 #turn NAs into 1's (insignificant) -- only NA values are on the diagonal (temp_f compared to temp_f etc)
{ # open pdf graphics driver
  pdf(file = "Figures/YSI/04_Correlations/02-YSI-Correlations-Correlogram-PValues.pdf",
      width = 13, height = 10)
  corrplot(cor_mat_stats$r, method = "number", type="full", order="original", 
           diag = TRUE, 
           tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, mar = c(0, 0, 4, 0),
           p.mat = cor_mat_stats$P, sig.level = 0.05, insig = "blank",
           title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean Water Quality Significant Correlations \n
           P-Value < 0.05")
  # close graphics driver
  dev.off()
}

```
